entities.summary: Ayoub Ahmani Sørensen is a Danish futsal player who plays for København Futsal and the Denmark national futsal team. A former professional footballer, he played as a winger, most notably for Lyngby and SønderjyskE in the Danish Superliga. Born in Morocco, he has also represented the Morocco U20 team.
